abstract_evidence_excerpt: Micro-aeration can facilitate anaerobic digestion (AD) by regulating microbial communities and promoting the growth of facultative taxa, thereby increasing methane yield and stabilizing the AD process. This review describes the applications of micro-aeration in AD and examines the cutting-edge advances in how methanogens survive under oxygen stress
